creates limits. Note that unlike `createsLimitOfReflectsIso`, to apply this result it is

    [CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape J F] =>
  {
    CreatesLimit := fun {K} =>
      have __ReflectsLimit := ⋯;
      { toReflectsLimit := __ReflectsLimit,
        lifts := fun c hc =>

theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.CoconeTypes.precompose_pt.{w₁, w₀, w₀', v, u} {J : Type u}
  [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor J (Type w₀)} (c : F.CoconeTypes)
  {G : CategoryTheory.Functor J (Type w₀')} (app : (j : J) → G.obj j → F.obj j)
  (naturality :
    ∀ {j j' : J} (f : j ⟶ j'),
      app j' ∘ ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (G.map f)) =
        ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.map f)) ∘ app j) :
  (c.precompose app naturality).pt = c.pt

theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.CoconeTypes.isColimit_precompose_iff.{w₁, w₀, w₀', v, u} {J : Type u}
  [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} J] {F : CategoryTheory.Functor J (Type w₀)} (c : F.CoconeTypes)
  {G : CategoryTheory.Functor J (Type w₀')} (e : (j : J) → G.obj j ≃ F.obj j)
  (naturality :
    ∀ {j j' : J} (f : j ⟶ j'),
      ⇑(e j') ∘ ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (G.map f)) =
        ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom (F.map f)) ∘ ⇑(e j)) :
  (c.precompose (fun {j'} => ⇑(e j')) ⋯).IsColimit ↔ c.IsColimit
